description: This file contains a Java class 'UserRepository' that provides database operations related to user data, such as count, find, insert, delete, and update, using JDBC template.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Repository class for performing CRUD operations on users table using JDBC.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of user records in the database.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all users from the database.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a user by their unique ID, returning an Optional<UserDto>.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Finds a user by their email, returning an Optional<UserDto>.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new user record with email and name, returning the created UserDto.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a user by ID, returning true if successful.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates email and name for a user identified by ID, returning an Optional<UserDto> with updated data if successful.
